pages.text: $(item)Harmonic of Vitality$()$(br2)A frequency tuned to growth and life. It carries the resonance of things that flourish.
$(bold)Attunement$()$(br)Strike an Unattuned Fork against a fully grown crop, or against any animal. This will tune it to become the Harmonic of Vitality.

$(bold)Use$()$(br)Shift-Right-click around crops to release a wave of resonance around you. This will apply random growth ticks to nearby crops, enabling them to grow faster. Right-clicking near animals will entice them to breed, if used directly on baby animals, it will advance their growth timer, without needing to be fed first.$(br2)The effect has a short cooldown between uses.
